items.text: We've just released a new major update for Bloomtown! We've just released an update for Bloomtown, chocked full of new items, enhanced quest rewards, improved localisations and much more! Check out the full details of the patch on the discussion forums or at the bottom of this blog. Thanks to everyone's feedback, which helped us find bugs, improve the game, and implement better rewards and items in the game. We appreciate every piece of feedback that you provide, so don't hesitate to take the time to leave a review of Bloomtown on Steam!
If you want to report a bug, issue, typo, or share feedback, there are two ways to do it:
Through our official Discord server
Via our customer support website
If you need info on what to include - you can find a dedicated Steam forum post here.

notes.title: What can you expect in this patch?

items.text: We've implemented new enhanced versions of items, enhanced side quest rewards, improved the balance of combat, and lots more. Let's go over some of the most important of these changes in more detail:

You'll find 20 enhanced versions of previously seen character equipment, including weapons, armor, and accessories. These will help improve your character's combat abilities more gradually as you progress through the game.

When completing side quests, you will notice that the rewards have been improved, offering far greater bonuses. This change increases the benefits of completing side quests, making the compensation more tempting.
We've slightly increased spell damage for both allies and enemies. This change improved combat speed, as some enemies were too spongy.

We've reduced the number of consumables in crates, but the size of cash rewards and crafting resources has been increased to compensate. This shifts the importance from working with the specific items you are provided in dungeons; now, you have the freedom to craft the tools you require or want with the resources provided.

Based on the feedback we have received since release, we have made a large number of updates to the various localisations of Bloomtown. You should now find improved texts and more accurate translations in all game versions.
Changed the player reward system. Significantly increased rewards for side quests.
Added over 20 enhanced versions of characters equipment.
Demons will now transfer more experience during Fusion.
Changed the balance of combat.
Reduced the number of consumables in dungeon crates but increased the number of cash rewards and resources for crafting.
Bugs were fixed in the training room.
Improved localization for all languages.
Fixed a delay between messages and choices in the dialogue system.
The achievements transfer between the demo and the full game now works correctly.
Fixed a softlock when the player presses some combination on the keyboard or gamepad during cutscenes.
Fixed some bugs in cutscenes.
Fixed empty description for starter equipment.
Fixed issues with the garden when it rains.
Fixed visual artifacts in the forest battle scene.
Fixed issue interface "to be" shop.
Fixed visual bugs in dungeons.
Fixed a softlock when players interact with the bench at the fair.
Fixed quest “ask Sam about stones”.
Fixed the quest with mint
When creating a new save/overwriting an old one, the new one is now displayed at the top of the list instead of at the bottom
Fixed a bug with the lottery not working correctly (the limit on the number of participants per day could be reset)
Removed delays for skip text baubles
Updated locales

Hello, Bloomtowners!
We just wanted to thank you for all of your feedback, bug reports, and support that you have taken the time to send to us.

Since our two previous updates after launch we have already released another five additional patches! We are attempting to resolve any bugs and issues found as swiftly as possible, so expect even more to come in the future.
If you want to report a bug, issue, typo, or simply share feedback, there are 2 ways to do it:
Through our official Discord server
Via our customer support website
If you need info on what to include - you can find a dedicated Steam forum post here.
You can find all of the patch notes for your demon-slaying needs, below:
Fixed problems with crafting in Gloomtown.

The 'Werewolf trophy' item was not correctly given for defeating a werewolf in the 'Proof of Power' subquest; it will also be added automatically to everyone who killed a werewolf and did not get the item.
Players could have fewer 'Stone plates' than needed despite finishing the corresponding subquest in the 'Stone collection' quest. The missing number of plates will be automatically given to players.

Fixed a bug where players couldn't use the Telescope activity (in Staff & Parts shop) after finding the equipment needed for the upgrade. It can now be used any day after loading the game if you have completed the corresponding side quest.

Achievement 'At the bottom of the sea' can now be obtained after catching all types of fish at least once without catching an additional fish. Players who caught all kinds of fish and didn't get an achievement only have to catch one more fish to get a trophy.
Now, when you complete one of the quests, “Holy man's advice” or “Science man's advice,” the other one will be automatically completed.
Fixed a bug that allowed players to participate in the activity “Telescope” an unlimited number of times per day.
Fixed a bug that caused the game to softlock when receiving a reward for the activity “Telescope” at maximum levels of social stats.
Fixed incorrect saving of new elemental resistances obtained when fusing demons.
Fixed a bug that prevented players from getting vinyl records from the “Shooting Range” activity.
Fixed a bug where players could not get into Gloomtown after being defeated by Lucifer.
Improved monster balance.
The game will no longer crash on Nintendo Switch when there is no Demo data to load.
Corrected an incorrect dialog sequence in the “Criminal Peanuts” quest.
Players can no longer insert all the tiles in the puzzles with statues and enter the asylum building without attacking the gardener.
The hint for this puzzle is no longer needed as we disabled the puzzle itself. Now, you can just insert the tiles.
Lewis' meal recipes are no longer available before completing the "Find the cook" quest.
Some another minor fixes in cutscenes and locales
Thank you for all the bug reports and feedback you took the time to send us!
We have already rolled 2 updates since release, as to address issues and implement improvements as fast as we can :)
If you want to report a bug, issue, typo, or simply share feedback, there are 2 ways to do it:

If you need info on what to include - you can find a dedicated Steam forum post here.

We have heard your feedback, here are the changes implemented to decrease the number of misses during combat:
emons’ evasion stat has been erased. You can still miss but it would not be because of the monster evading the attack.
Rebalancing of accuracy formula for less misses during combat.
